error.cannot_connect: The photo frame did not answer. It only does while it is on screen.

data_description.api_key: The key shown in the launcher settings, under Photo frame.
data_description.url: Address shown in the launcher settings, such as http://192.168.1.50:47915.

user.description: Open the photo frame on the device first: it only answers while it is on screen.

cannot_connect.message: The photo frame could not be reached. It only answers while it is on screen.

data_description.sensors: A climate entity shows its current temperature, anything else its state. The emoji goes before the value. The link, a Home Assistant view such as /home/living-room, opens when the value is tapped.

show_notification.description: Shows a message on top of the photos, above the ones already shown, with an optional link and end. The frame keeps the latest three.

duration.description: Minutes before the notification hides itself. Empty or 0 keeps it until newer ones push it out.
duration.name: Duration

link.description: Opened on tap, on a touch screen: /path opens that Home Assistant view in its app, homeassistant:// and https:// links are opened as they are.
link.name: Link

message.description: Text to show. A message already shown moves back to the top. An empty message clears the tagged notification, or all of them.
message.name: Message

tag.description: Identifies the notification, as on a phone: a new message with the same tag replaces it, an empty message with it clears it alone.
tag.name: Tag

show_notification.name: Show notification
